turns.text: Yes, please. How do I get to the City Museum from here?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Take exit B. Then walk straight along the river for about ten minutes. The museum is on the other side of the bridge.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Exit B. It's at the end of the station, near the stairs.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: OK. Exit B, then along the river, and across the bridge. Is it far?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Not really. About ten minutes on foot. Or you can take bus number twelve.

turns.speaker: Learner
